title: Full affine etale restriction is an equivalence for Type (u + 1)
statement:
theorem fullAffineEtale_large_sets_equivalence (S : Scheme.{u}) :
    ((fullAffineEtaleInclusion S).sheafPushforwardContinuous (Type (u + 1))
      (fullAffineEtaleTopology S) S.smallEtaleTopology).IsEquivalence

proof.text: The special-cocontinuity conditions give covering by image objects and local equality and lifting; fullness supplies the latter on identity coverings. Standard finite affine covers map to full-site covers.

Every covering of an affine etale object has a finite affine refinement. Hence the topology generated by the standard affine coverings is precisely the induced small etale topology, and the full inclusion is a dense subsite.

Extend an affine sheaf by compatible families on affine covers. Refining covers and applying the sheaf condition proves independence and the sheaf property. Restriction of this extension is the original affine sheaf. A full-site sheaf is recovered from its restriction by its sheaf condition. The same gluing gives mutually inverse maps on Hom sets, so restriction is an equivalence. All families and compatibility conditions live in Type (u+1), with no section-set resizing.
